//: Local development overrides. This file is TRACKED IN SOURCE CONTROL — unlike
appsettings.Local.json and appsettings.Secrets.json, it is NOT covered by .gitignore, so it must
never hold a credential. It held all 13 ConnectionStrings:* entries, including the production
SQL MI sqladmin password; those are now sourced the way Program.cs describes:
server  - Azure Key Vault, secret ConnectionStrings--<name> (e.g. ConnectionStrings--CoveConnection)
offline - appsettings.Local.json, which is gitignored and already carries the same 13 entries
The vault is registered after appsettings.Local.json, so it wins wherever both define a key.
Environment-only settings that are NOT secrets may be added here.
